items.title: Blue Bird Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Blue Bird (NASDAQ:BLBD) reported fiscal 2026 third-quarter revenue of $517 million and adjusted EBITDA of $71 million, as the school-bus manufacturer said it exceeded its guidance across metrics and raised its full-year adjusted EBITDA outlook. items.title: OSK Q2 Earnings Beat on Higher Sales, Strong Access Orders
items.summary: Oshkosh tops Q2 estimates as sales rise 6.7% and Access orders hit $1.5B, but margin pressure and a slower fire truck ramp trim its 2026 outlook.

items.title: CVNA Q2 Earnings Meet Estimates, Revenues Beat on Unit Growth
items.summary: Carvana's Q2 revenues jump 52% on record retail volume and strong pricing, while EBITDA grows despite margin pressure from expansion investments.

items.title: Uber robotaxis set for London debut after getting minicab licences
items.summary: Robotaxis are set to debut on the streets of London after Wayve was granted minicab licences by Transport for London (TfL).  A number of autonomous pure electric Ford Mustang Mach-E vehicles were approved for private hire vehicle (PHV) licences by Transport for London (TfL), Wayve said on Wednesday.

items.title: LCID Q2 Earnings Miss on Inventory Charges, Revenues Beat Estimates
items.summary: Lucid's Q2 revenues jump 56.2% and beat estimates, but a $300 million inventory charge widens losses and keeps margins deeply negative.

items.title: RIVN Q2 Earnings Beat on Software Growth, Regulatory Credits
items.summary: Rivian's Q2 loss narrows as software growth, regulatory credits and higher deliveries lift revenues, while R2 momentum drives a raised 2026 outlook.

items.title: Cummins Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates on High Costs, Revenues Beat
items.summary: CMI's Q2 revenues beat estimates. The company raises its 2026 outlook, but higher compensation, R&D, freight and coverage costs weigh on earnings and margins.

items.title: Pivotal Q2 Profits Show Stellantis Ready to Drive Turnaround. Time to Buy the Stock?
items.summary: Stellantis had a much-improved second quarter, but Wall Street still isn't buying. Should you?
